panels.title: Scorecard — live, per model (dashboard range)
panels.description: W/L and win% count one representative row per trade (chunk0). Net $ sums every fill. R uses the trigger's ORIGINAL stop; rows with unknowable risk (no stop, wz/rotation) carry r=0 and are excluded from R stats.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model, countIf(chunk0=1) AS trades, countIf(chunk0=1 AND outcome='closed' AND pnl_usd>0) AS wins, countIf(chunk0=1 AND outcome='closed' AND pnl_usd<0) AS losses, round(countIf(chunk0=1 AND outcome='closed' AND pnl_usd>0)/greatest(countIf(chunk0=1 AND outcome='closed' AND pnl_usd!=0),1)*100) AS win_pct, round(sum(pnl_usd)) AS net_usd, round(sumIf(r, chunk0=1),1) AS net_r, round(medianIf(r, chunk0=1 AND r!=0),2) AS med_r, countIf(chunk0=1 AND outcome='open') AS open FROM scanner.round_trips FINAL WHERE source='live' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY model ORDER BY net_usd DESC
SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, model, sum(pnl_usd) AS pnl FROM scanner.round_trips FINAL WHERE source='live' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time

panels.title: Daily net R by model (live)
panels.description: Signal quality in risk units — divergence from the $ panel means sizing, not signal.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, model, sumIf(r, chunk0=1) AS net_r FROM scanner.round_trips FINAL WHERE source='live' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, model, toFloat64(countIf(chunk0=1 AND outcome='closed' AND pnl_usd>0)) AS wins, -toFloat64(countIf(chunk0=1 AND outcome='closed' AND pnl_usd<0)) AS losses FROM scanner.round_trips FINAL WHERE source='live' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time

panels.title: Weekly net R by model (live) — the honest cadence
panels.description: Daily is noise for skewed strategies (most days small red, the week made by 1-2 runners). Judge on weeks / trade counts, not days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(toMonday(ts)) AS time, model, sumIf(r, chunk0=1) AS net_r FROM scanner.round_trips FINAL WHERE source='live' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cumulative R — backtest path (pre-arming) vs live (since arming)
panels.description: Same units (R per trade, brackets) on both sides. The backtest slope is what we funded; the live tail should look like a continuation of it. Zoom out for cameron's 3-year path.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS time, series, sum(day_r) OVER (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_r FROM (SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS day, concat(model, ' \u00b7 ', source) AS series, sumIf(r, chunk0=1) AS day_r FROM scanner.round_trips FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY day, series) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Signal R — ALL models incl. alert-only (forward-scored triggers)
panels.description: Every trigger's bracket replayed with slippage — the P&L of trigger-only algos (bohenfast/cameronfast/etc) and the signal-vs-execution comparison for armed ones. Fed by backtest.journal --ch.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model, setup, count() AS n, round(countIf(r > 0)/count()*100) AS win_pct, round(avg(r),3) AS avg_r, round(sum(r),1) AS total_r, round(medianExact(r),2) AS med_r, max(toDate(ts)) AS latest FROM scanner.signal_r FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY model, setup ORDER BY model, setup

panels.title: Daily signal R by model (forward-scored, incl. alert-only)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, model, sum(r) AS signal_r FROM scanner.signal_r FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time

panels.title: ALL models, same start — normalized backtest equity (100 = 2026-02-01)
panels.description: One common window for the whole fleet. R-models (cameron/bohen/smb/squeeze/lw/orb) from the unified backtest150 replay at 2%/R ($200 risk on a $10k nominal sleeve); weitzel/rotation/rsi2 are simulated %-return equity curves (frictionless, comparison-grade). Sleeves and brackets on one axis — read slopes and drawdowns, not absolute levels.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, idx FROM (SELECT toDateTime(d) AS time, series, idx FROM scanner.bt_equity FINAL UNION ALL SELECT day AS time, concat(model, ' \u00b7 backtest150') AS series, 100 + 2.0 * sum(day_r) OVER (PARTITION BY model ORDER BY day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS idx FROM (SELECT model, toStartOfDay(ts) AS day, sumIf(r, chunk0=1) AS day_r FROM scanner.round_trips FINAL WHERE source = 'backtest150' GROUP BY model, day)) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Calibration — backtest vs live, per model (all history, ignores range)
panels.description: Does what we witness match what we backtested? win% here = share of R-scored trades with r>0. Small live n — judge at n>=20 per the probation gates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model, source, countIf(chunk0=1) AS n, round(countIf(chunk0=1 AND r>0)/greatest(countIf(chunk0=1 AND r!=0),1)*100) AS win_pct, round(avgIf(r, chunk0=1 AND r!=0),3) AS avg_r, round(medianIf(r, chunk0=1 AND r!=0),2) AS med_r, round(sumIf(r, chunk0=1),1) AS total_r, min(toDate(ts)) AS from_d, max(toDate(ts)) AS to_d FROM scanner.round_trips FINAL WHERE r != 0 OR source='backtest' GROUP BY model, source ORDER BY model, source
